facts.text: Do the robes of Saint Arthur have any magical properties? Dr. Uriah judged them not cursed, but could not test them without Ingrid's witch powder.
Dr. Uriah wears the robes of Saint Arthur, holy robes of a saint of this world, and carries the quarterstaff found with them. Wearing them has had no notable effect so far.
Brother Dirk says the robes are far too holy to wear and is deeply offended that Dr. Uriah wears them. Will Dirk or his church seek to reclaim the robes or hold it against the party?
